name: a line of weeds growing along a crack with tiny wild flowers
label: wasteland_ruins/weeds-c
reasons: 화풍: 칸 정보량이 기준보다 훨씬 낮음 (4/4)

surfaces.part: weed clump with leaves along crack

answer.evidence: This is a ground decal of a weed clump with a few small flowers. The silhouette is irregular and widens from 3px at row 1 to 12px at rows 7-9, then narrows to 4px at rows 14-15. There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no ellipse and no vertical front face. The column scans show only leaf greens with scattered flower and soil pixels, so nothing reads as a standing volume. It is seen from above as a flat plate, which suits the flat kind.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny sprite of about 10x12 source pixels on a dark grey backdrop. It is not a 4x3-tile ground patch like the grass and paving references, which fill the tile area with continuous surface. The tile-based measured facts are 0 because the piece is smaller than one tile, so I judged by eye. It has only 12 distinct colours, with roughly 3 green steps plus small pink and red flower dots. The grass reference shows about 3 visible tones per tile with tufts and clumps, and the paving reference about 7 with per-stone shading. The edge pixels read as tinted dark green rather than neutral black, which is acceptable. There is no crack, no ground base, and no surface grain, so it reads as a small pasted-on clump. A careful artist would not accept it beside the references as a ground patch, so it fails.
